title: Add useful client notes and control visibility
summary: Save service context with a clear type, importance and appropriate visibility.

sections.title: Add a note
sections.body:
You need permission to manage client notes. Open the client profile and choose **Notes**.

1. Select **Add note**.
2. Choose **Note type**, such as General, Formula, Preference or Warning.
3. Choose **Visibility**. **Sensitive** is available only with the separate sensitive-record permission.
4. Enter required **Note content**.
5. Select **Mark as important** if authorized staff should see it prominently before a service.
6. Select **Add note** and verify its type, author and time in the list.

sections.title: Use the right kind of record
sections.body:
A profile note follows the client across permitted visits. A Calendar **Internal appointment note** belongs to that appointment. Choose the record that matches the purpose.

Keep notes accurate and necessary for service. An important note is a display priority, not an appointment alert, a notification to the customer or a clinical safety guarantee. Sensitive visibility limits readers; it does not make the product a medical records system.

sections.title: If you cannot see a note
sections.body:
**No visible notes added** means none are visible to your account. A sensitive note can exist without being shown to a person who lacks permission. Ask the owner to check access rather than copying private material into a less restricted record.

Notes show recorded authors and timestamps. Do not create a second note simply because a save response was interrupted; refresh and check the list first.
